topic: Limits of Polynomial and Rational Functions
title: Zero Over Zero, Stuck or Not? Limits Explained Simply | Class 11 Maths
description:
Diya has zero rotis to share among zero friends. How many does each friend get? Any number fits, so 0/0 has no single answer. But when a limit gives 0/0, it is not stuck: it is a signal to look closer. In this animated lesson for Class 11 Maths (NCERT Chapter 12, Limits and Derivatives) we learn the limits of polynomial and rational functions.

You will see why a polynomial's limit is just its value, sort rational functions into three cases, and watch the top and bottom of (x^2 - 1)/(x - 1) both shrink to zero live while their ratio settles at 2. We factor, cancel and plug in, test the NCERT shortcut lim (x^n - a^n)/(x - a) = n a^(n - 1), then do a worked example, the exam trap about 0/0, an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Follows the NCERT book. Useful for CBSE, ICSE (ISC), Karnataka PUC and other state boards, and JEE.
